notShown.what: A "Show My Impact" box that turns your own monthly amount, years and return into a story written by Arya.
notShown.why: The story part needs the website's AI. The sum itself is the SIP calculator on this phone (it uses the same formula).

notes: Each story is short and is told through an everyday example. The people in them (Ravi, Ankit, Rohit) are made up.
Rupee and percentage figures in these stories are statements from the website page. The page gives no source and no date for them.

blocks.text: vs waiting for "more income"

blocks.illustration: A made-up person. Any amounts in this story are illustrations, not data.
blocks.text:
Ravi earns ₹25,000 per month.
His friend says:
"Abhi mat invest kar, salary badhne de."
₹500 feels too small.
30 years feels too far.
blocks.title: A very Indian beginning

blocks.text:
Money is visible.
Time is invisible.
But time does the heavy lifting.
The earlier you start, the less you need.
blocks.title: Time vs Money

blocks.text:
Compounding is like a pressure cooker.
First 10 minutes — nothing.
Next 10 — steam.
Last 5 — explosion.
Most people turn off the stove too early.
blocks.title: Pressure Cooker Analogy

blocks.text:
₹500 × 12 × 30 = ₹1.8 lakh invested
Final value ≈ ₹1 crore+
Waiting 5 years can cost 30–40% of final wealth.
blocks.title: Reality Check

blocks.text:
Small money + long time
beats
big money + short time.
Always.
blocks.title: The real insight

blocks.text: vs financial flexibility

blocks.illustration: A made-up person. Any amounts in this story are illustrations, not data.
blocks.text:
Ankit is 27.
Family says:
“Rent is waste. Buy a house.”
Loan starts.
Freedom pauses.
blocks.title: A very Indian beginning

blocks.text:
A house locks money in one place.
Life needs money in many places.
blocks.title: Time vs Money

blocks.text:
A big EMI is like golden handcuffs.
Looks safe.
Limits movement.
blocks.title: The Handcuffs Analogy

blocks.text:
High EMI = low savings.
Low savings = high stress.
blocks.title: Reality Check

blocks.text:
A house is shelter.
Flexibility is wealth.
blocks.title: The real insight

blocks.text: vs a simple portfolio

blocks.illustration: A made-up person. Any amounts in this story are illustrations, not data.
blocks.text:
LIC, ULIP, FD, ELSS, Stocks, Crypto.
Rohit owns everything.
Understands nothing.
blocks.title: A very Indian beginning

blocks.text:
More products need more tracking.
Time leaks silently.
blocks.title: Time vs Money

blocks.text: Too many masalas spoil the sabzi.
blocks.title: Kitchen Analogy

blocks.text:
Simple portfolios often outperform
complex ones.
blocks.title: Reality Check

blocks.text: Discipline beats complexity.
blocks.title: The real insight

blocks.text: silent wealth killer

“Next year pakka.”
Life keeps happening.
Years pass.
blocks.title: A very Indian beginning

blocks.text:
Money can be increased.
Time cannot.
blocks.title: Time vs Money

blocks.text:
Miss the first train,
reach much later.
blocks.title: Train Analogy

blocks.text:
5 year delay =
30–40% less wealth.
blocks.title: Reality Check

blocks.text: Delay is expensive.
blocks.title: The real insight

blocks.text: safety vs real growth

Parents say:
“FD safest hai. Market risky hai.”
Money feels protected.
But it quietly loses power.
blocks.title: A very Indian beginning

blocks.text:
FD protects money.
Market grows money.
Inflation eats safety silently.
blocks.title: Time vs Money

blocks.text:
FD is a bucket with a small hole.
Money stays.
Value leaks every year.
blocks.title: The Leaking Bucket Analogy

blocks.text:
FD return: 5–6%
Inflation: 6–7%
Real growth = zero or negative.
blocks.title: Reality Check

blocks.text:
Safety without growth
is slow financial decline.
blocks.title: The real insight

blocks.text: tradition vs compounding

Gold means security.
Weddings, festivals, lockers.
Stocks feel uncertain.
blocks.title: A very Indian beginning

blocks.text:
Gold preserves value.
Equity multiplies value.
blocks.title: Time vs Money

blocks.text:
Gold is land.
Equity is crops.
Land sits.
Crops grow every season.
blocks.title: The Farm Analogy

blocks.text:
Gold: protects purchasing power.
Equity: creates new purchasing power.
blocks.title: Reality Check

blocks.text:
Gold protects wealth.
Equity builds wealth.
blocks.title: The real insight

blocks.text: protection vs wealth

LIC feels guaranteed.
Agents are trusted.
Returns are misunderstood.
blocks.title: A very Indian beginning

blocks.text:
Insurance is protection.
Investment is growth.
Mixing both weakens both.
blocks.title: Time vs Money

blocks.text:
Umbrella saves you from rain.
It doesn’t grow crops.
blocks.title: The Umbrella Analogy

blocks.text:
LIC returns ≈ 4–6%
Market investing historically higher.
blocks.title: Reality Check

blocks.text:
Insurance is for safety.
Investments are for wealth.
blocks.title: The real insight

blocks.text: lifestyle inflation trap

Salary increases.
Phone upgrades.
Bigger car.
Better house.
Savings stay the same.
blocks.title: A very Indian beginning

blocks.text:
Income rises fast.
Expenses rise faster.
blocks.title: Time vs Money

blocks.text:
More food on a bigger plate
still feels insufficient.
blocks.title: The Bigger Plate Analogy

blocks.text:
No investment increase
means no future freedom.
blocks.title: Reality Check

blocks.text:
Wealth grows only when
expenses grow slower than income.
blocks.title: The real insight

summary: Eight short five-step stories behind the cards on the Small Changes, Big Impact page: a very Indian beginning, time vs money, an analogy, a reality check and the real insight.
